    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    T = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        A = list(map(int, input[index:index + N]))
        index += N
        positions = [0] * N
        steps = 0
        for i in range(N):
            if A[i] == 0:
                positions[i] = i
            else:
                pos = positions[A[i]] + 1
                steps += abs(pos - i)
                for j in range(i, pos, -1):
                    positions[j] = positions[j - 1] + 1
                positions[pos] = pos
        results.append(steps)
    print(" ".join(map(str, results)))
